packs.title: Istiqlal Mosque (Masjid Istiqlal), Jakarta — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Indonesia’s national mosque in Central Jakarta, opposite Jakarta Cathedral. Open daily, no admission fee to enter; tourist hours can differ from prayer.

packs.title: Visiting Istiqlal Mosque: Hours and Entry — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Open daily: Masjid Istiqlal welcomes visitors, but tourist hours can differ from prayer and religious events. No admission fee to enter; confirm on the day.

packs.title: Istiqlal Mosque Dress Code and Etiquette — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Shoes off; modest dress covering aurat; women wear a jilbab or selendang. Non-Muslims may not enter the main prayer hall; upper hallways and terraces are visitable.

packs.title: How to Reach Istiqlal Mosque by Train and Bus — SanctaWay
packs.meta: KRL Commuter Line to Stasiun Juanda, then walk; TransJakarta at Halte Juanda or Halte Istiqlal. MRT, then onward toward Pasar Baru; car via Jalan Veteran.

packs.title: Istiqlal Mosque Best Time to Visit: Worship — SanctaWay
packs.meta: No official best month is published. Friday congregational prayer and Eid are the major worship events; Ramadan hours are year-specific, so check the notice.
